payload.core_mechanism_summary: Sequential scan over clock times from start, checking each with isValid (mirror-digit rules). No branching/pruning. Stops at first valid time.
payload.rationale: Exhaustive search over small state space (h*m <=10000). Not backtracking, no bitmasks, no graph. Rule suggests branch-and-bound; chosen loosely as it's complete search with no advanced technique. Low confidence.
